reviewer: sdk_review, with parallel review by root
scope: Entire SDK repository at the stated commit; all 461 tracked files
method: Read all textual source, tests, fixtures, documentation, build configuration, CI workflows, and wrapper scripts in bounded output chunks; reread truncated portions. Parsed Android vector XML structure. Inventoried binary media, development/test keys and signatures, and the Gradle wrapper JAR. Cryptographic assets and media were not treated as source text. Reading coverage does not imply executing every SDK component or a formal security audit.
